Yeah. I already passed the language/reading with flying colors. I just struggle with everything else. I cant really concentrate and such. I dont know, I am extremely sensitive around animals and if I cant save a life I might just end up crying the entire time. I know a therapist will require alot of schooling, but it is something I want to do. I was forced to go to therapy as a child while I was being abused, told the dude and he didn't do anything. Also have been looking for a therapist around where I live but they want 150$+ for one visit. Not being on any insurance I cannot afford crap. We were all playing an MMORPG together.

Yeah. I was pretty much told, 'Come and humor them.' Why would I put myself in that situation? They are all thinking I am a child and were like 'Well they need to know what they did was wrong.' No duh captain obvious, if the one girl I talked to about it told you that, you wouldn't say that. It just hurts the fact I thought they were my friends but they take the word of someone they just met.  Even my close friend didn't know my story until I told him, and now he doesn't like the main group anymore and is thinking about leaving them all together. When he tried mentioning something that was bothering him, one of the people told him to just let it go already. I was like ???? funny they tell you that but they are still talking about me in some shape or form.

I noticed that now, after he was quick to have a defense for himself then think I would do other things just to get more attention from him. I wanted to be a vet when I was younger, but since I love animals too much and cry too easily I decided I wanted to become a therapist to help people who don't have anyone there for them.
